name: forge-rest-conformance
description: REST API conformance oracle: validates a server against GitHub's published OpenAPI description

scripts.update-spec: node fetch-spec.mjs --update && node catalogue.mjs && node catalogue.mjs --spec dotcom
scripts.selftest: node run.mjs --base https://api.github.com --readonly --spec dotcom --report reports/selftest-github.json --md reports/selftest-github.md
